name: Meret
description: Meret is a Stars-faction Note-based support who distributes Sun, Moon, and Star Notes to key allies at battle start. Notes provide shields, attack buffs, and energy — and with Harmony of All Things, Note-bearers share damage with each other, creating a distributed damage pool. Her Artifact makes Note-bearers unkillable once, and her heals prioritize the weakest ally. Exceptional at keeping high-value units alive and amplifying their output simultaneously.

skills.name: Celestial Symphony
skills.description: At battle start, Meret distributes Sun, Moon, and Star Notes to the ally with the highest HP, the ally with the highest ATK, and herself. Upon activation, she triggers all Notes: Sun grants a shield, Moon increases ATK, and Star restores Energy.

upgrades.level2: Sun Note grants a stronger shield.
upgrades.level3: Moon Note additionally increases Crit Rate.

skills.name: Golden Step
skills.description: Heals the weakest ally every second for a duration based on a percentage of their max HP.

upgrades.level3: If the target has a Note, additionally restores a percentage of their max HP each second.
upgrades.level4: Increases duration of the healing effect.

skills.name: Curtain Call
skills.description: When any ally’s HP falls below a threshold, Meret heals them based on a percentage of their max HP. Each unit can trigger this effect once.

skills.name: Resonant Harmony
skills.description: All allies with Sun, Moon, or Star Notes share damage taken and gain additional effects: Sun increases max HP, Moon increases damage dealt, and Star increases Energy regeneration speed.

upgrades.level2: Sun Note further increases max HP.
upgrades.level3: Moon Note further increases damage dealt.
upgrades.level4: Star Note further increases Energy regeneration.

relic.name: Endless Melody
relic.description: When an allied unit with a Note takes fatal damage, they avoid death and gain a shield.

upgrades.level2: For each Note on the field, Meret gains damage reduction.
upgrades.level3: When a Note unit is about to die, the shield granted is increased.
upgrades.level4: While Notes exist on the field, Meret gains increased damage reduction.

synergies.description: Meret shields Hercules during ramp phase. Watch for energy timing conflict -- test whether output rhythm is disrupted.
Bastet as dodge frontliner, Meret as protective buffer behind. Stable combination for mid-length fights.
Set lifesteal aura combined with Meret protection for team sustain. Relevant in longer PvE encounters.

coreMechanic.summary: Diamond Support with protective life-sharing mechanics. Shields Hercules during ramp-up phase but can slow his energy recovery -- known tradeoff. Insufficient against high enemy burst. r1-10 enough for baseline utility; r30 for full protective output.

relicBreakpoints.effect: Baseline protection unlocked. Usable in Diamond team without further investment pressure.
Full protective capability. Only relevant once Hercules and Bastet are already at Divine.

f2pInvestment.notes: Baseline utility at r1-10. Full potential only realized at r30, and only if paired with high-investment Hercules and Bastet. Not a priority for F2P players until those conditions are met.
